articles.title: Trails In The Sky 1st Chapter Rolls Out Legacy Patch, Here Are The Full Details
articles.summary: Preparing for the future. articles.title: PSA: Play 10 Minigames For Free In Pictonico's Limited Time Event

Normally, players can only access three games in the demo. com

articles.title: Kingdom Hearts Voice Actor Hayden Panettiere Has Died At 36
articles.summary: She played the voice of Kairi. Following the Kingdom Hearts 25th anniversary celebrations at Disney's D23 fan event last week, a very sad announcement has been made. Hayden Panettiere, who voiced Kairi in the first two Kingdom Hearts games, has died at the age of 36.

articles.title: The Practical ASUS ZenScreen 16" 1080p Portable USB Monitor Is on Sale From Newegg via AliExpress

There's a difference between having a model of Boba Fett's armor and having a model of Boba Fett himself, and this set is decidedly the latter rather than the former.

articles.summary: First reported by Game Informer, Warner Bros. Discovery provided the slightest of acknowledgements that a sequel to 2023's Hogwarts Legacy is in the works as part of a recent letter to its shareholders. It's the sort of victory lap / "Gentlemen, to money!" deal you usually expect of the form, and I cannot overstate how tiny the HogsLegs mention is.
